agent-loop: 观察、执行、反馈：自治循环怎样工作
Observation, action and feedback in an autonomous loop
neural-computation: 从 y=ax+b 到一个神经元
training-corpus: 数据怎样进入训练，参数怎样计数
training-stages: 预训练、中训练与后训练
learning-signals: SFT 给示范，RL 看结果
SFT learns demonstrations; RL learns from outcomes
weight-quantization: 从 FP16、FP8 到 4 位量化
From FP16 and FP8 to 4-bit quantization
model-task-fit: 生态、装得下与业务匹配
Ecosystem, feasible size and task fit
harness-model-pair: 模型与框架：分开读，也要配合
Separate and coordinate model and harness
industry-value-map: 公司、模型版本与应用怎样分工
Companies, model versions and application roles

harness-responsibilities: 先读相关文件，组成这次上下文。
Read relevant files into this context.
模型提议修改，编辑工具实际写入。
The model proposes; an editor applies changes.
运行程序，取得输出或报错。
Execute and observe output or errors.
反馈回到模型，继续修订。

text-in-text-out: 刚才看到了输出；把背后的应用、模型和计算机分开，才知道每一步是谁完成的。
We have seen outputs. Separate application, model and computer to identify who performs each step.
model-application-compute: 模型接收的文字怎样变成数值？先从 Token 和编号看输入。
How does text become numerical input? Start with tokens and IDs.
token-pieces: 有了数值输入，接着看一个新片段怎样接回前文，让回答继续增长。
With numerical input, see how a new piece feeds back into the prefix to grow a response.
autoregressive-feedback: 每轮计算还需要利用前文；注意力说明不同输入怎样共同影响这一步。
Each prediction uses prior context. Attention shows how input positions contribute to this step.
attention-context: 刚才在增加文字序列；视觉生成还可以反复修改一个噪声状态，两种更新对象不同。
We grew a text sequence. Visual generation can instead repeatedly update a noisy state.
diffusion-steps: 模型怎样更新已说明；生成作品还要把要求、候选和修改连成工作流程。
The generation mechanism is in place. A finished artifact also needs requirements, candidates and revision.
creative-workflow: 作品流程从要求开始；把“写文章”补成受众、结构和材料，就能看提示词具体改变什么。
A creative workflow starts with requirements. Make audience, structure and material explicit in an article prompt.
article-prompt-template: 两段结构已经清楚，但模板不会知道真实日期；把通知和相关信息送进这次上下文。
The structure is clear, but a template does not know the date. Supply the notice and relevant information in context.
context-packet: 材料可能不在聊天里；先检索相关段落，再放入本次输入，便得到 RAG。
Material may be outside the chat. Retrieve relevant passages and supply them in the current input: RAG.
rag-retrieval: 检索只是一个工具。把读取、写入、电脑操作都拆成调用与返回，就能理解实际执行。
Retrieval is one tool. Separate file and computer operations into calls and returned observations.
tool-roundtrip: 工具执行已接通；还要有人组织上下文、任务进度和下一轮，这些属于 Harness。
Tools can now execute. A harness organizes context, progress and the next round.
harness-structure: 知道外围程序有哪些部分后，沿一次观察、动作和反馈，看循环怎样真正推进任务。
After identifying harness components, follow observations, actions and feedback through one task.
agent-loop: 循环会改变外部状态；接着区分改文稿、改助手、改模型，避免把所有循环都叫自进化。
Loops change state. Distinguish artifact, assistant and model changes before calling something self-improvement.
three-improvement-loops: 说“改模型”之前，先看能力怎样进入系统：人工写规则，或从例子学习参数。
Before model improvement, examine how behavior enters a system: written rules or learned parameters.
rules-and-learning: 规则和学习已经分开；现在实际算一个线性关系与神经元，让参数不再只是名字。
Having separated rules and learning, compute a linear relationship and neuron so parameters become concrete.
neural-computation: 神经网络内部的计算模块，与多个完整 Agent 是不同层面；现在看系统怎样拆任务协作。
Neural computation modules differ from complete agents. Now examine task-level coordination.
multi-agent-handoffs: 任务拆开并不自动更快；用同一份工作比较串行、并行和协调时间。
Splitting tasks does not guarantee speed. Compare serial work, parallel work and coordination.
parallel-time: 前半场看系统怎样工作。休息十分钟后，从训练数据开始，解释这些参数怎样学来。
The first half examined working systems. After a ten-minute break, use training data to explain how their parameters are learned.
training-corpus: 数据与参数的计数清楚了，再看训练材料和信号怎样按阶段变化。
With data and parameter counts clear, examine how curricula and signals change across training stages.
training-stages: 这些阶段会更新参数；把它与使用已有参数回答本次问题区分开。
These stages update parameters. Distinguish them from using learned parameters on a current request.
training-vs-inference: 学过不等于会处理新题；保留评测任务，检查学到的能力能否迁移。
Learning examples does not prove transfer. Hold tasks out to check performance beyond training.
held-out-evaluation: 考试怎样评分已清楚；回到训练，拿真实后续与预测分布比较，计算一次损失。
After scoring evaluation tasks, return to training and compare observed continuations with predicted probabilities.
target-and-loss: 有了数值训练目标，再分清示范输出和结果奖励两种信号如何组织学习。
With a numerical objective in place, distinguish demonstrated outputs from outcome rewards.
learning-signals: 结果奖励还不是优化中的全部比较；减去基线能看出这次表现相对好在哪里。
Outcome reward is not the whole learning comparison. A baseline reveals relative performance.
reward-and-advantage: 现在知道一轮训练的信号，再把视角放大：数据、模型和总计算预算怎样共同分配？
Having explained one learning signal, widen the view to data, model size and total compute allocation.
training-budget: 训练预算决定形成怎样的模型；模型完成训练后，还能在单个任务上增加推理计算。
Training allocation forms the model. Afterwards, a single task can receive additional inference compute.
test-time-compute: 计算次数以外，参数本身也要存储；把模型规模换算成具体的字节数。
Beyond computation count, parameters must be stored. Convert model scale into bytes.
model-weight-size: 知道需要存多少数，再看芯片怎样存、搬和算，才能解释运行速度。
Knowing storage requirements, examine how chips store, move and compute values.
gpu-compute-data: 减少每个数的位数可以减少存储和搬运，但要实际观察数值近似产生的误差。
Reducing bits can save storage and movement. Observe the numerical approximation and its errors.
weight-quantization: 单卡还可能装不下完整模型；分到多卡以后，必须传递中间结果。
A model may still exceed one card. Splitting it requires communication of intermediate results.
gpu-interconnect: 物理通路已连好；集群放置服务，推理引擎才负责加载、生成与通信。
With physical paths available, the cluster places services and the inference engine loads, generates and communicates.
cluster-engine-path: 服务开始运行后，用一条请求的时间线看等待发生在哪里。
Once serving runs, trace one request's timeline to locate waiting.
latency-timeline: 一位用户的等待与所有请求的总产出不同；再比较批处理怎样影响吞吐。
One user's wait differs from aggregate production. Compare how batching affects throughput.
aggregate-throughput-batching: 把单次计算放回持续系统：电力、散热、网络、引擎一起支撑长期产出。
Place individual computation inside a sustained system of power, cooling, networking and engines.
factory-input-output: 资源和指标都已有含义，现在回到实际任务，决定怎样选模型和工具链。
With resources and metrics defined, return to a real task to choose a model and toolchain.
model-task-fit: 选型会遇到总参数与激活参数两个数字；打开 MoE 路由看它们为什么不同。
Selection involves total and active parameter counts. Open MoE routing to explain the distinction.
expert-routing: 规模读懂以后，还要确认输入输出模态；会看图与会画图不是同一规格。
After interpreting scale, check modalities: understanding an image differs from generating one.
model-modalities: 模型规格只描述一部分；实际工具工作还取决于它与框架的接口和反馈组织。
Model specifications are only part of the system. Tool work also depends on harness interfaces and feedback.
harness-model-pair: 配合不只是模型名称；再看不同框架究竟承担了哪些文件、工具和状态工作。
Coordination involves more than model names. Compare responsibility for files, tools and state.
harness-responsibilities: 承担的工作不同，测试也要看完整交付；保持条件一致，分开比较模型与框架。
Different responsibilities need complete-system evaluation. Hold conditions fixed to separate model and harness effects.
pair-comparison: 把比较方法落在真实代码上：生成修改后运行测试，观察字典序与数字排序的差别。
Apply the comparison to code: execute a sort and observe lexical versus numeric ordering.
coding-example: 代码能运行是计算机任务的反馈；科学预测还需要实验和测量提供另一类反馈。
Execution checks a computing task. Scientific predictions require experimental and measurement feedback.
protein-structure: 预测与验证形成工作环；同样的方法也能改变日常整理、写入和复核的分工。
Prediction and validation form a work loop. The same principle can change everyday extraction, writing and review.
meeting-workflow: 工作分工说明了应用价值；最后把模型、应用和算力供应放进产业图里。
Work allocation explains application value. Place models, applications and computing providers on an industry map.
industry-value-map: 产业图里有许多层，我们的平台只在模型服务和集群资源这一层。
The industry has many layers; our platform occupies model serving and cluster resources.
platform-location: 把问题定位到模型、应用或计算层，再回到对应的例子，最后五分钟用于讨论。
Locate each question in the model, application or compute layer and return to its example for the final discussion.

demonstration: 先看未核对的教学候选 381，再用计算器得到 391，指出多做一步带回了什么信息。
Compare the unchecked toy proposal 381 with calculator result 391, identifying the useful new information.
pause: 强调这是一个核对算例，不是所有“多想”都会更好的结论。
Emphasize that this is a checking example, not proof that more reasoning always helps.
questions: 这一步是在重新训练吗？
Is this retraining?
没有更新参数，增加的是当前任务里的计算与反馈。
No parameters update; the current task receives additional computation and feedback.
391 怎样算？
How is 391 obtained?
为什么还要记延迟？
Why record latency too?
新增步骤要花时间和计算；要比较任务结果与这些代价。
Extra steps cost time and compute, which must be compared alongside outcomes.

demonstration: 先读笼统要求，再展开两段模板，最后放入周四 14:00、报告厅的真实通知。
Read the vague request, reveal the two-paragraph template, then supply the Thursday 14:00 auditorium notice.
pause: 问听众：模板能否凭空知道活动日期？
Ask whether a template can know an event date by itself.
questions: 为什么“写得专业”还不够？
Why isn't “write professionally” enough?
它没有说明受众、内容结构和事实材料。明确第一段背景、第二段活动信息，才能形成可检查要求。
It omits audience, structure and facts. Specify background first and event details second to make the request concrete.
模板里哪部分每次要换？
What changes between uses of a template?
主题和真实通知等材料要换；受众、段落结构与输出要求可以复用。
The subject and actual notice change; audience, structure and output requirements can be reused.
材料怎样交给模型？
How does material reach the model?
把真实通知与指令组织进这次上下文，不能只把模板写得更长。
Supply the real notice with instructions in the current context; longer template wording cannot replace it.

demonstration: 先读散热规则，再读同义关系，最后用三条费用记录找 a、b。
Read the cooling rule, the explicit alias relation, then infer a and b from three fares.
pause: 让听众指出：哪一种知识由人写明，哪一种数值从记录学习。
Ask which knowledge is written explicitly and which values are learned.
questions: 专家系统为什么不等于 LLM？
Why is an expert system different from an LLM?
前者显式编码领域知识与推理规则；后者从数据调整大量参数。应用可以组合二者。
Expert systems encode domain rules; LLMs learn many parameters from examples. Applications can combine them.
皇帝与皇上的关系怎样存？
How is the emperor/sovereign relation stored?
知识图谱可写成实体—别称—实体的连线；这条关系本身不能解决整句翻译的语序与指代。
A graph can store entity–alias–entity. One alias relation does not solve sentence ordering or reference in translation.
怎样从规则走到学习？
How do we move from rules to learning?
用样本约束可调整的数，下一步实际算一次加权和。
Use examples to constrain adjustable values, then compute a weighted sum.

demonstration: 先算 a=2、b=3 的三条费用；再展开神经元，改第一个输入为 −2。
Check fares with a=2,b=3, then reveal the neuron and change its first input to −2.
pause: 停在 −0.8→0，让听众说出 ReLU 做了什么。
Hold at −0.8→0 and ask what ReLU did.
questions: 为什么需要非线性？
Why add a nonlinearity?
单纯叠加线性变换仍可合成线性变换；非线性让多层组合表达更复杂关系。
Linear maps compose into another linear map. Nonlinearities let layers express richer relationships.
1.2 怎样算出来？
Where does 1.2 come from?
2×0.5+1×0.2+0=1.2. With first input −2, the sum is −0.8 and ReLU outputs zero.
这怎样接到训练？
How does this lead to training?
先知道参数怎样影响输出，再用预测误差决定怎样调整参数。
First see how parameters affect outputs; then use prediction error to guide updates.

demonstration: 把诗句切成教学 Token；分别读 Token 数、参数数量单位和 Byte。
Split the teaching sentence, then distinguish token counts, parameter units and bytes.
pause: 让听众换算 35B 是多少个参数，不先算显存。
Ask how many parameters 35B counts before discussing memory.
questions: 为什么语料要变成 Token？
Why turn a corpus into tokens?
分词器把内容转成模型可处理的序列；Token 不固定等于一个汉字。
A tokenizer produces a sequence for the model. A token need not equal one Chinese character.
35B 是 35 GB 吗？
Does 35B mean 35 GB?
不是。B 表示十亿，35B 是 350 亿个参数；空间还要乘每个参数的表示大小。
No. B means billion: 35 billion parameters. Storage also depends on bytes per parameter.
样本怎样改变模型？
How do examples change a model?
根据前文预测真实后续，计算损失，再更新参数；训练材料可以分阶段安排。
Predict observed continuations, compute loss and update parameters; curricula can change across stages.

demonstration: 按广泛语料、集中材料、示范与反馈展开三列；把早读／精读的比喻落回数据。
Reveal broad data, focused material, then demonstrations and feedback; connect reading analogies to actual data.
pause: 停在后训练列，让听众区分示范答案与偏好比较。
Hold on post-training and distinguish demonstrations from preference comparisons.
questions: 每个模型都必须有中训练吗？
Does every model require mid-training?
这个名称没有统一的必经定义，常指基础模型上的集中数据或目标训练。
It is not a universal required phase; it often refers to focused data or objectives after base training.
RLHF 怎样用人类反馈？
How does RLHF use human feedback?
反馈帮助形成奖励信号，再以强化学习塑造行为；不表示人逐字给每次更新打分。
Feedback helps form rewards for reinforcement learning; humans need not score every update word by word.
训练完以后怎样用？
What happens after training?
推理使用已有参数处理当前输入；参数更新与当前上下文变化要分清。
Inference uses learned parameters on the current input. Separate parameter changes from context changes.

demonstration: 先读三条评分条件，再运行，再逐项标出两项完成、一项未完成。
Read the three rubrics, run the candidate, then mark two completed tasks and one failure.
pause: 在 2/3 处停住，指出这个数没有解释失败原因。
Hold at 2/3 and point out that the aggregate does not explain the failure.
questions: 为什么不只考训练过的原题？
Why not test only rehearsed examples?
那样难以区分记忆与迁移；保留题用于观察未参与这次训练的任务表现。
That confuses memorization with transfer. Held-out tasks examine behavior beyond the training examples.
完成率怎么算？
How is completion calculated?
按事先规定的条件逐项核对，三项里完成两项就是 2/3；仍保留失败项、时间和用量。
Score each task against the predefined rubric. Two of three is 2/3; retain failures, time and usage.
模型出题能直接当考试吗？
Can model-generated questions be used directly?
先核对参考答案与评分，再保留未用于调参的题；自动生成不能代替核对。
Check reference answers and scoring, and reserve untuned tasks. Automatic generation does not replace checking.

demonstration: 读真实后续“原”，对齐四个候选和 one-hot 目标，再播放概率与损失变化。
Read observed 原, align candidates with the one-hot target, then animate probability and loss.
pause: 让听众先找到第三项，再读 −ln(0.2)。
Locate candidate three before reading −ln(0.2).
questions: Why is the target [0,0,1,0]?
本例真实出现第三个候选“原”；这个向量标记观察，不是另一组模型猜测。
The observed next item 原 is candidate three. The vector marks that observation, not another model guess.
How does 1.609 become 0.511?
The target probability rises from 0.2 to 0.6: −ln(0.2)≈1.609, −ln(0.6)≈0.511. Other probabilities adjust so the sum stays one.
为什么接着讲 SFT 与 RL？
Why discuss SFT and RL next?
它们以不同方式提供训练信号；先分清示范与结果评分，再谈优化方向。
They organize training signals differently. Distinguish demonstrations from outcome scores before discussing updates.

demonstration: 左边给纪要及示范表；右边不给完整程序，只运行测试评分。
On the left provide a summary demonstration; on the right run tests without supplying the complete program.
pause: 请听众指出：哪边直接给期望输出，哪边评价尝试的结果。
Ask which side supplies an output and which scores an attempt.
questions: SFT 是否只适合有唯一答案的题？
Does SFT require one unique answer?
不需要；可以有多种合理示范。关键是训练样本给出期望输出，而非仅有结果分数。
No. Several demonstrations may be valid. The key is supplying demonstrated outputs rather than only outcome scores.
测试通过率怎样成为奖励？
How can test success become reward?
先运行生成的程序，再按通过比例或其他任务规则形成数值反馈；评分设计决定学到什么。
Execute the program, then form feedback from test results or another task rubric. Reward design shapes what is learned.
奖励高就直接等于低损失吗？
Is higher reward the same as lower loss?
二者不是同一个量；下一步把奖励与基线作比较，得到优势。
They are distinct quantities. Next compare reward to a baseline to obtain advantage.

demonstration: 对照保留日期和漏掉日期的回答，给 1、0 分，再减均值 0.5。
Compare retained and omitted deadlines, award 1/0 and subtract the 0.5 mean.
pause: 先让听众算 1−0.5，再解释更新方向。
Have learners compute 1−0.5 before discussing learning direction.
questions: 为什么奖励还要减基线？
Why subtract a baseline from reward?
优势表达相对预期的好坏；本例用组均值作基线，真实方法也可采用其他基线。
Advantage expresses performance relative to expectation. The group mean is one illustrative baseline among several possibilities.
两个优势怎样算？
How are the two advantages computed?
这里的分数能代表所有 RL 吗？
Do these scores define every RL method?
不能。奖励、基线、优势和优化目标依算法而变；这里解释它们的不同用途。
No. Rewards, baselines, advantages and objectives vary by algorithm. This example separates their roles.

demonstration: 固定 N×D=16，先选 N=4，再选 N=16，观察数据量与玩具损失。
Fix N×D=16, compare N=4 and N=16, then read data allocation and toy loss.
pause: 在 N=16、D=1 处停下，解释大模型为什么没有免费增加预算。
Hold at N=16,D=1 and explain why size did not increase the budget.
questions: 为什么不能只把模型做大？
Why not maximize model size alone?
固定预算下，每个 Token 更贵会挤掉数据或其他计算；规模规律需要数据、模型和预算条件。
At fixed compute, higher cost per token leaves less data or other work. Scaling depends on model, data and budget together.
图里的最小值怎样得到？
Where does the toy minimum come from?
D=16/N，代入 N^−0.5+D^−0.5；本例 N=D=4 时损失为 1。它不是实测能力曲线。
Use D=16/N in N^−0.5+D^−0.5. At N=D=4 the toy loss is 1. This is not measured model capability.
推理时多想属于同一种扩展吗？
Is extra inference work the same scaling axis?
训练数据和参数规模形成模型；推理时计算用于一个当前任务，需要另看结果与延迟。
Training data and parameter scale form a model; inference compute is spent on the current task and needs separate outcome/latency measurement.

demonstration: 依次读 2.8T、16 bit=2 Byte、乘法和 5.6 TB，再指出缺少的运行内存。
Read 2.8T, 16 bits=2 bytes, the multiplication and 5.6 TB, then identify excluded runtime memory.
pause: 让听众说出这里为什么还不能给出 GPU 张数。
Ask why this does not yet determine GPU count.
questions: 参数量为什么不能直接换成人的智力？
Why can't parameter count be converted to human intelligence?
参数只是在模型中可调整的数；质量还取决于数据、方法、任务和使用方式。
Parameters are adjustable numbers. Quality also depends on data, methods, tasks and use.
5.6 TB 怎样来？
Where does 5.6 TB come from?
2.8×10¹² 个值，每值 2 Byte，得到 5.6×10¹² Byte，即十进制 5.6 TB。
2.8×10¹² values times 2 bytes gives 5.6×10¹² bytes, or decimal 5.6 TB.
为什么还要讲芯片和带宽？
Why discuss chips and bandwidth next?
存得下不等于算得快；还需要搬运数据、执行运算，并存放缓存与工作区。
Fitting is not the same as running quickly. Data must move, arithmetic must execute, and caches/workspace also need memory.

demonstration: 先核对 8 bit=1 Byte；用步长 0.25 重建三个权重，再改 0.125 观察截断。
Check 8 bits=1 byte. Reconstruct three weights at step 0.25, then switch to 0.125 to expose clipping.
pause: 停在 1.23→0.875，让听众解释为何步长更小反而有大误差。
Hold at 1.23→0.875 and explain why a smaller step produced more error.
questions: 4 bit 为什么能减少存储？
Why does 4-bit storage save space?
每个值只占 4 位，理想紧凑编码一 Byte 放两个值；实际还需要缩放信息及较高精度部分。
Each value uses four bits, ideally two per byte. Real formats also store scaling metadata and higher-precision parts.
步长 0.125 为什么截断？
Why does step 0.125 clip?
1.23/0.125≈9.84 rounds to 10, exceeding signed 4-bit maximum 7, so reconstruction is 7×0.125=0.875.
位数减半就一定快两倍吗？
Does halving bits guarantee twice the speed?
不保证。实际速度取决于硬件、内核、搬运与工作负载；质量还要回原任务比较。
No. Hardware, kernels, data movement and workload determine speed. Quality must be tested on the actual tasks.

demonstration: 先把四份权重放进不同卡，再显示连线，最后播放中间状态经过各卡。
Place four shards, reveal the links, then move intermediate state through the cards.
pause: 停在连线出现而请求未移动时：有线还不等于有分片执行。
Pause after links appear: wires alone do not implement sharded execution.
questions: 为什么多卡需要交换数据？
Why must GPUs exchange data?
模型拆在多卡上，各卡计算自己负责的部分；后续计算需要前面产生的中间结果。
Each card computes its portion of a split model; later computation needs intermediate values from earlier work.
四张 24 GB 卡就等于一张 96 GB 卡吗？
Are four 24 GB cards automatically one 96 GB GPU?
不是。程序或引擎必须实现分片和通信；设备与拓扑也要支持相应并行方式。
No. Software must implement sharding and communication on supported devices and topology.
Kubernetes 和推理引擎分别做什么？
What do Kubernetes and an inference engine do?
集群放置服务；引擎加载模型、安排生成计算与通信。它们是不同层的工作。
The cluster places services; an engine loads weights and executes generation and communication at another layer.

demonstration: 用纪要、排序和检索三个任务，先定标准，再观察结果及未完成项。
Define rubrics for notes, sorting and retrieval, then inspect outcomes and the failed item.
pause: 先问任务需要什么，再读品牌名和规模。
Ask what the task requires before discussing brand or size.
questions: 为什么最大模型未必最适合？
Why might the largest model be unsuitable?
权重能装下还不够；上下文、并发、延迟、工具链和稳定完成任务都需要比较。
Fitting weights is only a start. Compare context, concurrency, latency, toolchain support and consistent task completion.
怎样做一个公平的本地比较？
How can we compare locally?
固定输入、工具、评分和尝试次数，记录是否完成、关键错误、时间与用量。
Fix inputs, tools, scoring and attempts; record completion, errors, time and usage.
MoE 为什么要单独说明？
Why explain MoE separately?
它区分完整存储与本次激活计算，直接影响怎样读参数规模与设备需求。
It separates stored parameters from active computation, affecting how model size and device needs are interpreted.

demonstration: 读四个专家的存储范围；先看 A 的路由，再切 B，比较专家和加权输出。
Show all stored experts, route A, then switch to B and compare selected experts and output.
pause: 让听众先找到未选专家：它们仍在模型中。
Locate the unselected experts: they remain in the model.
questions: MoE 专家是几个 Agent 吗？
Are MoE experts separate agents?
不是。专家是同一模型内的参数模块；Agent 是组织模型、工具与动作的系统。
No. Experts are parameter modules inside one model; an agent organizes model use, tools and actions.
A 的组合结果怎样算？
How is A's mixed output computed?
选分数 0.5 和 0.25，归一化成 2/3 和 1/3；乘专家输出 2、4，得到 8/3。
Select scores 0.5 and 0.25, normalize to 2/3 and 1/3, then mix outputs 2 and 4 to obtain 8/3.
A3B 为什么不表示 6 GB 总权重？
Why doesn't A3B imply 6 GB of total weights?
激活只数本次计算的参数，完整 35B 权重按统一 FP16 粗算约 70 GB，另有运行开销。
Active counts refer to one token's computation. All 35B weights at uniform FP16 would be about 70 GB, plus runtime overhead.

demonstration: 分别指出三列的输入和输出，不以公司名称代替规格。
Identify each column's inputs and outputs; do not replace specifications with company names.
pause: 请听众区分“看图写字”与“根据文字画图”。
Distinguish describing an image from generating one.
questions: 会看图片就一定能生成图片吗？
Does image understanding imply image generation?
不一定；前者输入图像输出文字，后者输出图像，具体接口和模型不同。
No. One consumes images and produces text; the other produces images, with different models and interfaces.
怎样给视频模型准备任务？
How is a video task specified?
先确认支持的文字、参考图片或其他输入，再明确视频输出要求。
Check supported text, reference-image or other inputs, then specify the required video output.
为什么还要看模型与框架配合？
Why examine the model-harness pair next?
任务还依赖材料、工具和反馈的组织，模型名称不能代表完整工作系统。
Task outcomes also depend on context, tools and feedback; a model name does not specify the complete working system.

demonstration: 固定 A+X，先只换模型，再只换框架，读清每次变了哪一个因素。
Start at A+X, change only the model, then only the harness; identify each variable.
pause: 明确图中没有伪造的性能分数，也没有声称具体产品可任意互换。
Note that no performance scores or universal product compatibility are implied.
questions: Codex 与 GPT 是同一种名称吗？
Do Codex and GPT name the same kind of thing?
这里 Codex CLI 指组织编程工作的软件，GPT 指模型家族；应用和模型版本分别识别。
Here Codex CLI names coding-agent software, while GPT names a model family. Identify software and checkpoint separately.
为什么换一个工具名字也会影响工作？
Why can changing a tool name affect execution?
read_file(path) 与 open_document(file) 对程序不是同一接口，参数和结果需要正确适配。
read_file(path) and open_document(file) are distinct interfaces; arguments and observations need matching adapters.
Kimi Code→K2.5 是永久配对吗？
Is Kimi Code→K2.5 a permanent pairing?
不是；应用可更新服务模型。这里保留它作为具体版本例子，当前规格应查看官方来源。
No. An app can update its serving model. It remains a versioned example; check official sources for current specifications.

demonstration: 保持同一个排序修复任务，分别列 A+X、A+Y 和 B+X；逐项说明比较因素。
Keep the same sort-fix task and compare A+X, A+Y and B+X one variable at a time.
pause: 先说哪些条件保持一致，再讨论谁完成了实际修改。
State the fixed conditions before comparing actual completed edits.
questions: 为什么不能只比较一段正确答案？
Why not compare only correct answer text?
写出代码与实际写回文件、运行测试是不同交付；完整系统要记录它真正完成了什么。
Returning code differs from applying edits and running tests. Evaluate what the complete system actually delivered.
怎样分开模型和框架的影响？
How can we separate model and harness effects?
固定 A 比较 X、Y；固定 X 比较 A、B，同时保留任务、工具和评分条件。
Compare X/Y under fixed A, then A/B under fixed X, holding task and scoring conditions comparable.
这怎样帮助实际工作？
How does this inform real work?
以真实交付、时间与返工更新分工，而不是根据一次惊艳演示推断普遍能力。
Update work allocation from delivered outcomes, time and rework rather than one impressive demonstration.
